the-mythology-of-conscious-ai-spya-rn5m0.text: Seth gives several separate reasons to doubt that computation alone could make an AI conscious. How do they fit together? Do they depend on each other, and which of them carries most of the weight in his conclusion that we should not try to build conscious AI?
What does Seth mean when he says a simulation is not an instantiation? Is that convincing? What would a functionalist say back, and does the essay answer that reply or only assert its own view?

entropy-24-00930-spya-pywwkq.text: Why do the authors say that mutual information and transfer entropy are not enough to describe information processing in neurons, and how does that motivation connect to what the empirical PID studies in section 5 actually found?

What exactly is 'synergy' in PID, and how far should I trust the finding that synergy concentrates in rich clubs and recurrent connections? What could the choice of redundancy measure, or the amount of data, do to that result?
